name: ponder-chat
description: Ponder Chat: a chat app on OpenRouter models, with a daily credit limit per person.

scripts.build: PONDER_PAGE=chat vite build && PONDER_PAGE=admin vite build && tsx scripts/compress-web.ts && nitro build
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/vue-tsc.cjs --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.vue.json && npm run typecheck:browser
scripts.lint: tsx scripts/no-suppressions.ts && npm run lint:vue && oxlint && tsx scripts/no-any-casts.ts
scripts.lint:vue: npm run api-types && node --require ./scripts/typescript5.cjs node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --concurrency auto "web/**/*.vue"
scripts.typecheck:server: tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2022 --strict --skipLibCheck --allowImportingTsExtensions types/json.d.ts
